The mentions-plan proposal is clear, so I rewrote nothing and sent nothing. `node Server/text-check.mjs` on its folder printed no flags.

I read it only as an agent brief and did not open any page. It states the ask in one paragraph. It has two numbered jobs, the past-work table and the counts script. It ends with the exact log line to append.

I appended one `clear` line to `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.
